The '''Yiulimar Ice Fjords''' were located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Neftali/Legends|Neftali]], south of the [[Yiuli Mountains]]. The area was known for hosting [[swoopchasing]] events.<ref name="BSS" />
